Developer Platform & Public REST API v1

Integrate 150+ online tools into your applications using REST APIs, SDKs, and Embeddable Widgets.

REST API v1 Overview

Base API URL: http://localhost:8000/api/v1

All API requests accept standard JSON payloads and require an X-API-Key or Bearer token header. Rate limits are 60 requests/minute for standard accounts.

Available Endpoints

GET /api/v1/tools - List all public tools
GET /api/v1/categories - List all categories
POST /api/v1/tools/{id}/execute - Execute tool action
